title: ALMA observations of 99 GHz free-free and H40α line emission from star formation in the centre of NGC 253
question: Use ALMA 99 GHz free-free continuum and H40alpha emission to derive electron temperature, photoionizing photon rate, SFR and dust attenuation in the centre of NGC 253

data.sensitivity: Noise per 3.9 MHz channel: 5.2 mJy (total), 0.9-1.3 mJy (regions)

what.value: Near-infrared Pabeta and Brgamma line fluxes and attenuation values A_J=2.00±0.36, A_K=0.87±0.16

evidence.quote: values of $A_J=2.00 \pm 0.36$ and $A_K=0.87\pm0.16$ for an attenuation sheet as reported by (cite: engelbracht98)

what.value: Emissivity and effective recombination coefficient alpha_B tables (case B, ne=1e3)

evidence.quote: interpolated between the $\epsilon_\nu$ values from (cite: storey95) for case B recombination

what.value: Radio-to-mm SED data used to refit free-free fraction

evidence.quote: (cite: rodriguezrico06) found a much smaller contribution of free-free emission to the central 30 arcsec

recipe.method: Recalibrate in CASA, rescale EB amplitudes to J0137-245, concatenate, clean to cubes with and without continuum
key_parameters: natural weighting, 0.1 arcsec pixels, 3.9 MHz channels

recipe.method: Measure H40alpha flux, mean velocity, FWHM in continuum-subtracted cube; continuum by fitting and removing line; integrate over central 20x10 arcsec and E, C, W regions
Refit SED of Rodriguez-Rico et al. allowing synchrotron slope to vary
Solve line-to-continuum ratio equation for Te using interpolated Storey & Hummer emissivities
Starburst99 conversion; SFR from line and continuum equations adapted from Scoville & Murchikova
key_parameters: Z=0.040, Kroupa IMF 0.1-100 Msun, average of zero and 40% break-up rotation Geneva tracks
assumptions: Continuous star formation >5 Myr; D = 3.44 Mpc

recipe.method: Compare Engelbracht et al. Pabeta and Brgamma fluxes to 0.7x total H40alpha flux assuming attenuating sheet
assumptions: ne=1e3 cm^-3, Te=6200±400 K, sheet geometry

evidence.quote: We calculate electron temperatures of 3700-4500 K
with a FWHM of $191\pm4$ km s$^{-1}$

not_stated_but_needed: CLEAN threshold, iteration count and mask definitions
Line-free channels used for continuum fitting and order of baseline fit
Exact SED data points and fit used to derive 70% free-free fraction
Region definitions for E, C, W
Engelbracht line fluxes used for attenuation
score_reason: Public data and a clear analytic recipe, but imaging and SED-fit details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric results from explicit equations, though some inputs are not given.
